brandVoice.shouldSound: Confident without being arrogant. Solution-focused, empowering, authentic, and inspiring. Speak directly to the listener as an ambitious peer.
brandVoice.shouldNotSound: Overly salesy, desperate, pushy, generic, robotic, or filled with hollow buzzwords.
brandVoice.wordsToUse: Mastery, Craftsmanship, Elevate, Exponential, Unrivaled, Precision, Proven, Transformative, Scalable
brandVoice.wordsToAvoid: Cheap, Quick fix, Guaranteed overnight, Secret hack, Cheap trick, Spammy offers
brandVoice.languageGuidelines: For high-reach Instagram reels, conversational Hinglish with natural phonetic English spelling connects best. For LinkedIn and formal reports, polished global English is required.
brandVoice.formalityLevel: Balanced (Mix of both: Approachable yet distinctly professional)
punctuationStyle: Use question marks to spark reflection
brandVoice.correctExamples: “True growth isn’t about chasing every trend—it’s about building a brand so compelling people can’t ignore you. Here’s how we did it in 90 days. 👇”
brandVoice.incorrectExamples: “CLICK HERE TO GET RICH QUICK! Guaranteed 500% sales in 24 hours or money back! Don’t wait! BUY NOW!!”

scope.approvalProcess: 1. Drafts shared via Client Portal & Drive -> 2. Client reviews & leaves specific comments -> 3. Revisions applied (if any) -> 4. Final approval marked.

approvalTimeline.noResponseClause: If no feedback is received within 48 hours, drafts are deemed approved to maintain posting schedule.

revisionPolicy.roundsIncluded: 2 Rounds of revisions per content deliverable
revisionPolicy.coveredScope: Pacing adjustments, music changes, caption revisions, text corrections, crop edits
revisionPolicy.additionalCharges: Additional major re-edits outside original brief charged at ₹1,500 per deliverable

paymentTerms.dueDate: Due on the 1st of every calendar month
paymentTerms.terms: Payment via NEFT / RTGS / UPI to agency corporate account

scope.additionalWorkCharges: Ad hoc extra reels: ₹3,500 each. Extra carousels: ₹2,000 each. Dedicated ad creatives: ₹2,500 each.
scope.adSpendPolicy: Client maintains their own Meta / Google Ads billing method. Agency manages campaign configuration and creative testing.
scope.communicationChannel: Official communication via WhatsApp Business Group and email. Bi-weekly video strategy calls on Google Meet.
scope.communicationSla: Standard response time within 2-4 business hours during working hours (Monday - Friday, 10:00 AM - 6:30 PM IST).
scope.cancellationPolicy: 30 days written notice prior to the start of the next billing cycle.
scope.ownershipPolicy: Full intellectual property rights for published creatives transfer to the client upon receipt of full payment. Agency retains portfolio showcase rights.
scope.rawFilePolicy: Finished high-resolution master video and image files are provided. Raw project project files (.prproj, .aep) available upon special request.
